name: Michele Patrick Carbone
office: City of Rancho Palos Verdes, Member of the City Council

items.text: Michele Patrick Carbone is a health care consultant. According to her campaign, she has a background in medical technology and quality assurance management and is a board member of the Abalone Cove Association. Her campaign says she has advocated for local control and housing issues through Our Neighborhood Voices and Livable California.

items.text: At an October 2026 candidate forum, she named landslide and road maintenance, wildfire preparedness, crime prevention, and fiscal security as her top priorities. She says she would bring a data-driven approach to the council.
